write_behavior: none; every command emits canonical JSON to stdout and the root controller persists create-only bytes with apply_patch

execution_root.constraint: resolved contained directory strictly beneath successor_20260813

closed_world_layout.<slot>/rendered/<cell>.txt: exact frozen harness render storage when persisted

capture_envelope.binding: Verifier reconstructs the entire envelope from the only derived direct-appserver receipt; equality and key order are exact and the envelope binds the receipt storage bytes.
capture_envelope.nonconforming_calls: Capture envelope is still required. No replacement semantic capture is admitted.

commands.emit-capture: Derive the only legal capture envelope from the completed receipt.
commands.admit: Require exact frozen next cell, all earlier scores PASS, required deterministic artifacts valid, no later evidence, and only positive no-start controller invalids.
commands.validate-cell: Bind receipt/capture/render, classify subject conformance, and invoke the harness stage scorer for permanent PASS or FAIL.
commands.validate-artifact: Recompute a deterministic stage and require byte-identical persisted storage.
commands.validate-controller-invalid: Validate a derived contiguous invalid receipt and report no-start recreation eligibility.
commands.path-terminal: Emit an honest permanent first-failure, controller-invalid, or complete-pass path terminal and forbid downstream evidence after failure.
commands.matrix-terminal: Recompute all path terminals, require persisted equality, enforce global thread and turn disjointness, and emit honest accounting.
commands.call-accounting: Emit exact matrix-level expected, started, completed, PASS, FAIL, INVALID, missing, ineligible, retry, best-of, replacement, and unique-identity counts.
commands.reopen-matrix-terminal: Recompute and require byte-identical persisted matrix terminal and subject-call accounting, then emit exact terminal storage and payload bindings.
commands.qualify-two-runs: Require consecutive sequence 1 then 2, identical candidate freeze digest, two persisted complete-clean matrices, zero controller-invalid attempts, exact 582-call accounting, and globally disjoint threads and turns across both runs.

permanent_fail_conditions: not exactly one assistant final message
not exactly one text content item
non-UTF-8 text impossible under receipt schema
stage response schema or semantic mismatch

causal_rules.no_start_recreation: only contiguous preserved invalid receipts with subject_call_started exactly false

terminal_rules.clean_path: all frozen cells completed and PASS plus byte-valid S90 bounded_causal_simulation_pass
terminal_rules.failed_path: first valid subject FAIL is permanent and no later evidence may exist
terminal_rules.clean_matrix: three COMPLETE_PASS paths and globally unique threads and turns
terminal_rules.failed_matrix: valid honest terminal with exact calls, PASS, FAIL, missing, and zero retry/best-of/replacement accounting

nonclaims: This verifier is disposable and not a production security boundary.
A valid terminal applies only to the frozen throwaway fixture and candidate bytes.
One clean matrix is not two-run qualification.
